description: Blind report-only analysis of EDT and ERL mixture/reference run reports. Includes a deterministic Python parser and automated tests.

interface.defaultPrompt: Analyze this EDT/ERL report with blind ingestion and explain the mixture/reference patterns, pruning, and evidence limits.
